Implemented IOMMU-backed DMA quiescence for BCM43602 PCIe: driver-neutral narf_io::iommu block_device_dma/restore_device_dma (Linux pci_dev_reset_iommu_prepare/_done; detach to the IommuHw blocking entry, default domain kept so live buffers still strict-unmap). Confirmed stop blocks after the D3/BME/flush proof before reclaim; dead-firmware stop blocks before the watchdog reset; an unproven generation is freed only behind a completed block (BDF stays quarantined); attach restores before first allocation; native allocation runs in PerDomain via bus::dma::configure + alloc_coherent_for.
